justification: Direct use of attacker-controlled index without bounds checking against array size
analysis: The function takes an attacker-influenced index parameter that is passed directly to __ip_set_put_byindex without any validation. The index is used as an array offset to access inst->sets[index] without bounds checking against the actual number of sets. No length, offset or index arithmetic overflow/underflow issues are present, but the direct use of attacker-controlled index creates a potential out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability.
